<Activity x:Class="ExcelApplicationCard" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities" xmlns:ue="clr-namespace:UiPath.Excel;assembly=UiPath.Excel.Activities" xmlns:ueab="clr-namespace:UiPath.Excel.Activities.Business;assembly=UiPath.Excel.Activities" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <ueab:ExcelApplicationCard WorkbookPath="{x:Null}" ResizeWindow="None">
    <ueab:ExcelApplicationCard.Body>
      <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="ue:IWorkbookQuickHandle">
        <ActivityAction.Argument>
          <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="ue:IWorkbookQuickHandle" Name="Excel" />
        </ActivityAction.Argument>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Do" />
      </ActivityAction>
    </ueab:ExcelApplicationCard.Body>
  </ueab:ExcelApplicationCard>
</Activity>
